generator.algorithm: blake2b(counter_be64, key=utf8(seed), person='mainline-proj', digest_size=64) keystream; byte b -> +1 if b%6==0, -1 if b%6==1, else 0; row-major (out_dim, in_dim) int8

notes: PROVISIONAL AND NOT PCA. This is a sparse ternary (Achlioptas) random projection. It is committed so that the coarse sweep is runnable, reproducible and bit-stable offline; it preserves pairwise distances only in expectation (Johnson-Lindenstrauss) and preserves nothing about the corpus's variance structure. recall.md D4 requires a PCA fitted on real bge-large embeddings before any recall number is published: run fit_projection.py on a machine holding the pinned weights, which emits storage='raw_f32', fit_status='fitted', a fit_corpus_sha256 and an explained_variance_ratio, under a NEW projection_id. source_revision is null because the bge-large revision sha is not verifiable on the build machine; LocalBGE refuses to construct without an explicit revision argument rather than carrying an unverified default. Set MAINLINE_RECALL_REQUIRE_FITTED_PROJECTION=1 to make loading this artefact a hard failure.
